message: The other day, I found myself in a flurry trying to pack our family's go-bags. It was chaos! I had my kids debating over which stuffed animal was essential (spoiler: they all are), while I was frantically typing in our family group chat, trying to keep everyone in the loop. It turned into a hilarious back-and-forth about who would carry what, and I realized that even amid the packing frenzy, it was the laughter and teamwork that really mattered. So, if you find yourself in a similar situation, don’t forget to keep the lines of communication open—it's a great bonding moment. What’s your favorite way to keep your family connected during prep time? 😊
